map.A4 纸下月消耗与安全库存: Next-Month A4 Paper Consumption and Safety Stock
map.：近 6 月 A4 纸消耗：12,14,11,13,15,12（箱）。取移动平均: : A4 paper use over the last 6 months: 12, 14, 11, 13, 15, 12 (boxes). With a moving average window of 3, the mean of the latest three months = (13+15+12)/3 ≈ 13.33 boxes; with a safety stock factor of 1.2 the safety stock is about 16 boxes. Next month, stock "forecast 13.33 + safety 16" ≈ 29 boxes, then subtract current stock when ordering.
map.移动平均窗口怎么选？: How Do You Choose the Moving Average Window?
map.窗口越小越敏感（紧跟近期波动），越大越平滑（抗单月异常）。消耗平稳的耗材用 3-: A smaller window is more sensitive (tracking recent swings) and a larger one is smoother (resisting single-month anomalies). For steady consumables a 3–6 month window is enough; for strong seasonality or promotion spikes use a wider window or forecast in segments. The window only affects smoothing and never changes the historical data.
map.安全库存系数代表什么？: What Does the Safety Stock Factor Represent?
The factor scales "forecast demand" up to a "stocking target" to cover uncertain consumption during the lead time. A factor of 1.2 means stocking 20% above the forecast. A larger factor is less likely to run out but ties up more capital, so set it by weighing lead time against the cost of a stockout.
